summary: Verified the officer-payslip PDF cell-wrap fix (backend/utils/dispatch_reports.py -> build_officer_payslip_pdf). Wrote pytest regression that logs in as admin, generates + downloads the payslip PDF via /api/dispatch/payslip-records{,/{id}/pdf}, and uses pdfplumber to assert (a) HTTP 200 + body starts with %PDF, (b) every expected column header token is present, (c) NO word extends past the right page margin (proves cells wrap instead of overflowing), and (d) after seeding a schedule with a long post-site name + very long remarks, both long strings appear in the extracted PDF text (wrapped across multiple lines inside their own cell). Also drove the UI end-to-end (admin login -> Dispatch Portal -> Wage Report -> By Officer -> officer detail dialog -> Generate & Save Payslip PDF) and confirmed data-testid='entity-detail-dialog','payslip-table','payslip-header','generate-payslip' render and that clicking 'generate-payslip' produces the 'preview-payslip-<id>' link.
verified_behaviors: POST /api/dispatch/payslip-records -> 200, returns saved record with id, gross, net_payment, officer_name, client_name, pdf_url
GET  /api/dispatch/payslip-records/{id}/pdf -> 200, Content starts with b'%PDF', body > 3KB

pdfplumber extraction shows all column tokens (Date, Shift, Start, End, Time, Duty, Hour, Hourly, Rate, Total, Post, Site, Name, City, Pin, Remarks) - 'Duty Hours' visibly wrapped as 'Duty Hour' + 's' inside its own cell, exactly the intended behaviour of wordWrap='CJK'
No PDF word crosses the right page margin (0.5-inch) on any page for either the default or the long-text-seeded payslip

After updating a schedule with post_site_name='VeryLongPostSiteNameForWrapVerificationAlphaBravoCharlieDeltaEcho' and a ~200-char remarks value, both values appear (wrapped) in the extracted text of the regenerated PDF
UI: officer payslip dialog renders payslip-table + payslip-header; clicking generate-payslip creates preview-payslip-<id> links successfully
critical_code_review_comments: build_officer_payslip_pdf uses fixed 8pt/leading 10 for cells and wordWrap='CJK'. CJK wraps mid-word (byte-by-byte), which is what fixes the overflow but produces mid-word breaks like 'VeryLong\nPostSite...'. If the design wants word-boundary wrapping for ASCII-heavy content, consider ParagraphStyle wordWrap=None (default) with allowSplitting and slightly wider column weights, so wrapping happens at natural word breaks and CJK is only used as fallback.

The 'city' and 'post_pin' fields for a schedule row come from the post-site document, not the schedule itself, so PUT /api/dispatch/schedules/{sid} with {city, post_pin} silently ignores them. From a bug-testing perspective this made seeding long values harder; not a functional bug in the PDF fix but worth exposing an admin-side way to override per-schedule (or updating the post-site doc directly).
dispatch_reports.py is now 2699 lines and mixes several PDF builders. Consider splitting into report-specific modules (payslip, invoice, advance) for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Test updates an existing Aug-2026 dispatch schedule for officer 'Abir Vai' (client Arseas Security Services INC) with long post_site_name + long remarks in-flight, then regenerates the payslip. No new schedules created; test is idempotent and re-runnable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression file at /app/backend/tests/test_payslip_pdf.py. Run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest backend/tests/test_payslip_pdf.py -v -o addopts=''. Note that /app/backend/pytest.ini forces pytest-xdist which spawns 2 workers - the module-scoped session fixture is safe but pytest.PAYSLIP_PDF_BYTES sharing across tests requires them to run in the same worker (they do because of loadscope). If the Aug-2026 seed data is wiped, the fixture falls back to 2025-01-01..2027-12-31 to find any schedule.
rca of the issue:
Fix verified. Root cause pre-fix: payslip table cells were raw strings which ReportLab renders as a single non-wrapping line, causing long post site names / remarks / pins to spill past their column boundary. Fix wraps every header/body/footer cell in a Paragraph with ParagraphStyle(wordWrap='CJK'). Verification: pdfplumber shows the wrapped long remarks 'This is an intentionally very
long remarks value used to
verify that ReportLab wraps
the content inside the cell
...' and the assertion 'no word x1 > (page.width - 0.5in)' passes on the long-text payslip PDF.
